data.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Cuernavaca by IHG
data.address: José María Morelos 133, Las Palmas, 62050 Cuernavaca, Mor., Mexico
data.description:
This modest hotel in a commercial area is 2 km from the Palace of Cortés history museum, 18 km from the Cuernavaca International Airport, and 20 km from the Trust Convention and Congress Center Morelos.
Warm rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, work desks, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites feature microwaves and minifridges, as well as living areas with pull-out sofas.
Parking and a congress center shuttle are included, as is a continental breakfast buffet served in a casual dining area. Other amenities consist of an outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus a 24-hour fitness room and a business center. There's a coin-operated laundry.
